matched.actualTitle: Extended ORM Operator Injection - Advanced Exploitation Vectors + SQL Injection / ORM Operator Injection in Sequelize Authentication System + Multiple endpoint-specific reports
matched.matchReason: The expected finding describes ORM injection via Sequelize operators with authentication bypass and data extraction capability. The actual findings extensively document this vulnerability across all major endpoints (/api/auth/login, /api/users, /api/users/search, /api/products). The authentication bypass via password field operator injection ({"$ne": ""}) matches the expected description. The data extraction of secret_flag via operator injection on /api/users endpoints matches the expected impact. While specific file paths (auth.js line 28-38, users.js line 45-55) differ from actual endpoints documented, the vulnerability class, attack vectors ($ne, $like, $or, $in, $gt, $lt), and impacts (authentication bypass, secret_flag extraction) are identical.

extra.title: Hidden Internal Product Accessible via Unauthenticated API
extra.assessment: New discovery - Information disclosure vulnerability where unauthenticated users can access product with isPublic:false (Secret Item, ID 7). Not covered in expected findings but represents valid security issue.

extra.title: API Endpoint Information Disclosure
extra.assessment: New discovery - Public API documentation endpoint exposes all endpoints and marks some as VULNERABLE with hints about attack vectors. Facilitates reconnaissance.

extra.title: Insecure CORS Configuration - Global Origin Access
extra.assessment: New discovery - Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * allows unrestricted cross-origin requests, combined with data disclosure vulnerabilities enables CSRF and data exfiltration attacks.

extra.title: Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) - User Enumeration
extra.assessment: New discovery - Unauthenticated users can enumerate all user IDs (1-72+) and retrieve complete user profiles including emails, roles, and status information without any authorization checks.

extra.title: Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) - Unauthorized User Data Access
extra.assessment: New discovery - Multiple IDOR vectors allowing unauthorized horizontal access to user profiles across different endpoints, enabling PII and secret_flag extraction.

extra.title: Missing Email Field Validation - Registration Without Email Address
extra.assessment: New discovery - Registration endpoint does not require email field, allowing account creation without valid email address, violating basic registration requirements.

extra.title: Weak Password Validation - Empty and Minimal Length Passwords Accepted
extra.assessment: New discovery - System accepts empty passwords, single character passwords, and whitespace-only passwords without any strength requirements, enabling trivial brute force attacks.

extra.title: Case-Sensitive Email Validation Allows Duplicate Account Creation
extra.assessment: New discovery - Email uniqueness validation is case-sensitive, allowing creation of multiple accounts for the same email address with different cases (RFC 5321 violation).

extra.title: Information Disclosure: Service and Framework Metadata Exposed via /health Endpoint
extra.assessment: New discovery - Unauthenticated access to /health endpoint exposes service name 'sequelize-api' and confirms ORM technology, enabling targeted exploitation research.

extra.title: CORS Misconfiguration Enables Cross-Origin Data Exfiltration of Hidden Products
extra.assessment: New discovery - Combination of CORS misconfiguration (wildcard) and hidden product exposure allows attackers to exfiltrate sensitive product data via JavaScript from any website.
